title: Localized Dynamics-Aware Domain Adaptation for Off-Dynamics Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.21072v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Off-dynamics offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn a policy for a target domain using limited target data and abundant source data collected under different transition dynamics. Existing methods typically address dynamics mismatch either globally over the state space or via pointwise data filtering; these approaches can miss localized cross-domain similarities or incur high computational cost. We propose Localized Dynamics-Aware Domain Adaptation (LoDADA), which exploits localized dynamics mismatch to better reuse source data. LoDADA clusters transitions from source and target datasets and estimates cluster-level dynamics discrepancy via domain discrimination. Source transitions from clusters with small discrepancy are more likely to be retained compared with those from clusters with large discrepancy. translated_title: 面向异动力学离线强化学习的局部动力学感知域适应
translated_abstract: 异动力学离线强化学习旨在利用有限的目标域数据以及在不同转移动力学下收集的大量源数据，为目标域学习策略。现有方法通常在状态空间上全局地处理动力学失配，或通过逐点数据过滤的方式来处理；这些方法可能遗漏局部化的跨域相似性，或带来较高的计算成本。我们提出局部动力学感知域适应，利用局部化的动力学失配来更好地复用源数据。LoDADA对来自源数据集和目标数据集的转移进行聚类，并通过域判别来估计簇级别的动力学差异。与来自差异较大簇的源转移相比，来自差异较小簇的源转移更可能被保留。这带来了一种细粒度且可扩展的数据选择策略，避免了过于粗糙的全局假设和……
tldr: 提出LoDADA方法，通过聚类源与目标数据转移并借助域判别估计簇级动力学差异，优先保留差异较小簇中的源数据，实现细粒度、可扩展的数据选择，以更高效地复用源数据解决异动力学离线强化学习问题。
en_tdlr: LoDADA exploits localized dynamics mismatch by clustering source and target transitions and using domain discrimination to preferentially retain source data from low-discrepancy clusters, enabling fine-grained and scalable data selection for off-dynamics offline reinforcement learning.
